title: These 4 GitHub Repos Make AI Agents WAY More Powerful #AI #AIAgents #GitHub
description:
What if your AI coding agent could become faster, cheaper, smarter, and even produce entire videos?

In this video, we're looking at 4 AI agent GitHub repos that are worth knowing if you're using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or other AI coding agents.

First is Graft, a tool designed to give coding agents better context about your codebase. Its published benchmarks report up to **4x lower cost and 3x faster performance, with fewer tool calls and fewer tokens in its tested workflows.

Second is Agency Agents, an open-source collection of specialized AI agents. The project currently lists 232 specialized agents across 16 divisions, covering areas like development, marketing, design, research, and more.

Third is Codebase Memory MCP. It indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph, allowing AI coding agents to understand relationships between functions, files, call chains, routes, and other parts of a project without repeatedly searching through everything. The project reports dramatically lower token usage for certain structural queries.

And fourth is OpenMontage, an open-source agentic video production system that can turn an AI coding assistant into a video production workflow covering research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and rendering.

The bigger trend here is interesting: AI agents are no longer just chatbots that write code.

Link: 

https://github.com/nanonets/graft

https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents 

https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage 

They're becoming systems you can extend with memory, specialized skills, tools, workflows, and entire production pipelines.
